note: Canonical list of the regular Last War activities Muse is expected to perform. Since 2026-10-26 the routine is split into 3 segment schedules in the same hour, 27 minutes apart - segment 1 at :03, segment 2 at :30, segment 3 at :57, each repeating every 4 hours, so the whole routine completes inside one hour of each 4 hour cycle and every regular still gets done once per cycle. Each segment checks and does its own regulars whenever they are available at that moment. Cadence: every-run = due again at the segment's next cycle (its own 4 hour boundaries); daily-reset = once per reset period (VIP, reset 19:00 local) but still checked whenever its segment runs; weekly-thu = Thursdays only. Game-side daily caps and counts limit how much can be done in a day, never whether a regular is checked. Scout layer (owner direction 2026-10-31, refined the same day): the regulars are a capability profile library, not a fixed timetable - execution units are produced when observation triggers fire (claimable now, deadline approaching, about to fill, state rotation, preparation opened, quota behind pace, floor check), ordered by deadline pressure times value over expected duration, and the clock remains only as the perception heartbeat and the game hard deadlines (the 19:00 reset, Arms Race phase windows, quota checkpoints). Two anchored daily-reset scout passes walk the whole game interface and record what is actually available to do - scout at the 19:00 reset (the post-reset full pass) and scout-midday anchored at 07:00 local (the midday pass) - but the anchors are the guaranteed floor, not the ceiling: a full pass also fires on detected state change, partitioned perception rolls with the ticker heartbeat, and the day work set is diffed from the freshest observation. Labels on screen that no profile owns are filed as provisional candidate profiles and explored under the new task discovery protocol in perception-driven-queue.md. Each scout pass runs as a homogeneous chain split by surface group; the staged unit is the chain head.

regulars.name: Mail - check every category and Claim All
Alliance help - Help All, plus the main-screen help bubble whenever it pops
Alliance gifts - Claim All on Regular and Premium tabs
Harvest all resource bubbles (center taps; one farmland tap collects all food)
VIP Daily Freebie - claim; claim again in any round after the 19:00 reset
Passes - weekly/monthly daily pickups and Free Supply in the shop
Daily missions - claim completed Mission tasks one by one, re-checking after each, and claim the activity chests at their thresholds
Secret missions - claim finished (one Claim takes all), Mega Deploy the rest (UR Only off; on duel UR days Mega Refresh first), check Reward Recovery
Hidden treasures - dig when a full set of 7 fragments is on hand (tab badge counts digs)
Radar - Quick Execute to empty, Claim All, do special pins individually, claim the free 75 stamina when offered
Survivor intake - take in the gate line, then Quick Dispatch in building panels
Trucks - settle returned trucks via Truck Details, claim trade Reward Recovery, dispatch to fill (duel UR days Mega + UR only, other days SR/SSR/UR), plunder to the cap by the UR shard rule
Alliance train - if a train is in preparation board carriage 2 with a 3-contract ticket; claim train arrival mail
Troop training - requeue any finished barracks at its highest tier
Alliance tech donations - every run: donate with the coin button to the recommended tech whenever today coin donations remain (never diamonds); claim the daily donation reward when claimable

Event claims - claim every earned reward on the Events screen and inside each event, including Battle Pass daily login, Halloween check-in while it runs and all Arms Race rewards; finish only after a final sweep shows no bouncing chest or reward red dot remains; never grind, never buy

Arms Race - read the phase and score; meet the live target; claim all earned rewards, not only the three point chests; return to the Events screen for a final sweep and claim any bouncing chest or reward red dot
Ghost Ops - event day only (Thursdays, server windows); help allies 3x, claim manually
Alliance Star Ceremony - when the trophy icon shows; send at least 3 hearts, claim the rewards
Scout - post-reset full perception pass (floor anchor, not the ceiling); walk the whole interface, record observed items and unmatched labels, do no work

Scout - midday perception pass (floor anchor); re-walk the interface for state-dependent availability (trains, phase rotations, market refreshes); full passes also fire on detected state change between anchors
